raw_response:
I am old woman, 78 years, never went school. My man died some years back, now just me and my grandson in house. 35 years I farm this land in Quzhou. My hands know the soil.

I have 10.1 mu. Not small, not big. My neighbor Old Wang, he plant wheat-maize same as me, that is what everybody do here. Cotton I keep little piece, maybe 1 mu, because cotton price not good now and cotton need much work, my back hurt. So wheat and maize main crops, about 9 mu each season, cotton 1 mu in summer.

For wheat, I plant in October. I buy seed from same dealer every year, the one from village shop, he sell improved seed, everybody use it, give good bread wheat. I use about 15 kg seed per mu, that is how I always do.

Fertilizer — I use the compound, what they call 二铵 (DAP), one bag 50 kg for about 2 mu as base. Then before winter I put urea, maybe half bag per mu. In spring when wheat green up, I put more urea, one bag for 2 mu. I do not know exact nitrogen number, but I know I put enough — my mother-in-law said better put little extra than see yellow wheat. Yellow wheat means hungry wheat, means no grain. I rather waste some money than have empty head.

Water — I have well, lucky. Wheat need water at planting, then before winter freeze, then in spring when it stand up, then when head come out. Four times usually. Maize I water 2-3 times, maize tough.

Pesticide — I spray wheat 2 times, once for the aphid (蚜虫), once before harvest for head disease. Maize I spray 1 time, for the borer. Cotton need more spray, 4-5 times, that why I not like cotton much.

Tillage — I pay tractor man to rotary my land before wheat. For maize I no till, just plant in wheat stubble, everybody do like this now, save money save time.

Yield — good year my wheat give 450 kg per mu, maize 550 kg per mu. I hope for this, but weather decide.
